CustomField.formula:
/* MONTH(LastModifiedDate) + ' ' + DAY(LastModifiedDate) + ', ' + YEAR(LastModifiedDate) + ' • ' + Size_Label__c + ' • ' + File_Extension__c
*/ if(ISBLANK(S3_File_Object__c), '', S3_File_Object__c & ' • ') + CASE(MONTH(DATEVALUE(LastModifiedDate)), 1, "Jan", 2, "Feb", 3, "Mar", 4, "Apr", 5, "May", 6, "Jun", 7, "Jul", 8, "Aug", 9, "Sep", 10, "Oct", 11, "Nov", 12, "Dec", "?" ) & ' ' & TEXT(DAY(DATEVALUE(LastModifiedDate))) & ', ' & TEXT(YEAR(DATEVALUE(LastModifiedDate))) & ' • ' & Size_Label__c & ' • ' & File_Extension__c
CustomField.label: File Info
